pending_commit.commit_message: UPSTREAM: mm: mark pages in use for page tables Define a new PageTable bit in the page_type and use it to mark pages in use as page tables. This can be helpful when debugging crashdumps or analysing memory fragmentation. Add a KPF flag to report these pages to userspace and update page-types.c to interpret that flag. Note that only pages currently accounted as NR_PAGETABLES are tracked as PageTable; this does not include pgd/p4d/pud/pmd pages. Those will be the subject of a later patch. UPSTREAM: mm: mmu_notifier fix for tlb_end_vma The generic tlb_end_vma does not call invalidate_range mmu notifier, and it resets resets the mmu_gather range, which means the notifier won't be called on part of the range in case of an unmap that spans multiple vmas. ARM64 seems to be the only arch I could see that has notifiers and uses the generic tlb_end_vma. I have not actually tested it. [ Catalin and Will point out that ARM64 currently only uses the notifiers for KVM, which doesn't use the ->invalidate_range() callback right now, so it's a bug, but one that happens to not affect them. CHROMIUM: mm: kstaled: a kswapd alternative kstaled differs from kswapd in the following respects: 1) kstaled walks page tables directly to clear the accessed bit on PTE. This allows kstaled to track the accesses of all mapped pages with even less CPU overhead comparing with the rmap. 2) kstaled stores a N-bit age, i.e., timestamp of the last access, for each page and sorts pages based on the age. This is a closer approximation to the LRU, which reduces swap refaults. 3) kstaled scans at a fixed interval to prevent thrashing. If it can't produce enough cold pages for reclaim to consume, allocation will be throttled to allow the tab discarder to take action. shill: Add mockable keyword In general, the virtual keyword is used for methods that are going to be mocked, even if those methods should not be inherited by non-mock children. This works fine for projects that have a flat or very simple inheritance hierarchy. Shill, however, has neither of those, and the most complex inheritance hierarchies (e.g. the Service and Device hierarchies) become much more difficult to read and understand when one is never sure if a virtual method is used just for mocks or is also overridden by children. This change creates a separate 'mockable' keyword for methods that should only be overridden by mocks. The 'mockable' behavior is enforced by being #defined to virtual only in test builds. camera: usb: Optimize capture pipeline with DMA-buf JDA/JEA The new JDA and JEA interfaces support DMA-buf backed input and output buffers, and support NV12 image format. This CL uses them in USB HAL to optimize the capture pipeline in reducing copies between DMA-bufs and shared memory. Typically when preview/still capture resolution is the same as camera stream resolution, the pipeline would look like: JDA JEA MJPEG V4L2 buf -----> NV12 gralloc buf -----> JPEG gralloc buf In other cases we still need conversions between temp I420 buffers since libyuv doesn't have rich NV12 support. See the comments in cached_frame.cc for the detailed conversion graph. This CL also enables GrallocFrameBuffer to allocate its own buffer in order to feed JDA/JEA.
